primary_external_evidence.observed_rule: verification compares the Statement subject to the digest of the artifact in question; provenance envelope authentication is a separate verification step
build timestamps can be normalized from a source-derived epoch
archive input order must be explicitly stable; filesystem enumeration order is not a reproducibility guarantee
ZIP_DEFLATED uses zlib; ZIP records expose order and metadata including timestamp/comment/extra/create_system/external_attr that are distinct from extracted file bytes

normalized_same_runtime_double_build.scope_note: same-runtime evidence only; no cross-host/toolchain reproducibility credit

hypothesis_resolution.hypothesis: An external ReleaseArtifactSubject/v1 that binds filename/size/SHA-256 of the unopened distributed artifact closes an evidence-subject gap without replacing the existing release manifest authority.
hypothesis_resolution.counterhypothesis: The current release_manifest_sha256 + prehandoff_receipt_ref pair is already sufficient for exact outer artifact identity.

verification_order: fail closed on artifact filename/size/SHA-256 mismatch
reject unsafe or ambiguous ZIP member topology before extraction
extract into a controlled temporary root
invoke the existing release-manifest verifier on extracted payload
bind clean-machine evidence to artifact_sha256 + release_manifest_sha256 + prehandoff_receipt_ref
architecture_refinement.authentication_boundary: Subject digest binding does not authenticate the external receipt by itself. A signature/envelope/root-of-trust mechanism is a separate later security property and receives no credit here.
architecture_refinement.reproducible_build_refinement: Stable paths/order/timestamps/metadata are necessary but not sufficient to claim cross-host byte reproducibility for compressed ZIPs. The build contract must also bind/characterize packaging runtime and compressor identity and pass cross-environment double-build comparison, or deliberately choose a packaging mode with stronger deterministic semantics when tradeoffs permit.

next_exact_gate: Acquire E4_F2_ABLATION_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_SUBJECT and demonstrate against exact-current F2 acceptance semantics that two equal-manifest/equal-receipt payload-equivalent outer ZIPs are observationally indistinguishable under the current contract but distinguishable after the proposed additive subject binding, without changing canonical payload authority.
